meta.title: Data corrections log
meta.rule: Every change Takwimu makes to a published value, label or citation that is not already a resolved case in data/conflicts.json is logged here with the original and corrected figure, the reason, the evidence (source and page), the date and the pages affected. scripts/test-corrections.js compares every value with the previous release's data (git main) and fails the build if a changed value has no entry here or in the register. Errors in the source documents themselves are not our corrections: they are flagged on the records (source_error) and listed separately on /corrections/.

entries.original: 53.8 per cent, cited to the county chapter's department table total, Controller of Budget FY 2022/23 report PDF p. 583 (printed p. 557)
entries.corrected: 53.8 per cent (unchanged), cited to Table 2.4, Siaya row, Controller of Budget FY 2022/23 report PDF p. 34 (printed p. 8)
entries.reason: The department table on PDF pp. 582-583 has no total row; 53.8, 1,520.28 and 2,827.00 are printed in the Siaya row of Table 2.4. Found when the machine cross-check did not find 53.8 on p. 583. The value and the open conflict with the text's 53.4 (PDF p. 578) are unchanged.
